-- Terminate active sessions from the implicated principal/address
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE usename = 'dba'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  AND client_addr = '10.20.9.5'::inet;

-- Safety check: remove bd_admin if statement [07] was incomplete

BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'bd_admin') THEN
    EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM bd_admin';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM bd_admin';
    EXECUTE 'DROP OWNED BY bd_admin';
    EXECUTE 'DROP ROLE bd_admin';
    RAISE NOTICE 'ALRT-0018: bd_admin role still existed and has now been removed';
  ELSE
    RAISE NOTICE 'ALRT-0018: bd_admin role confirmed absent';
  END IF;
END
$$;

-- Forensic quarantine table documenting irreversible audit_log tampering
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt0018 (
  note_id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  recorded_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  alert_id text,

);
